summary: Iteration 43 — JARVIS Aura v3 ✨ AI-card styling on Dashboard NowBriefCard verified end-to-end via browser automation (mobile 390x844, kishan quick-login). All 9 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) computed animation-name='aiCardGradient, aiBreathe' with durations '8s, 4s' and iteration 'infinite, infinite'. (2) backdrop-filter='blur(24px) saturate(1.8)' (browser normalises 180%→1.8, spec explicitly allowed). (3) border='1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)' (top/right/bottom/left all match). (9) Zero new console errors — only pre-existing ElevenLabs 401 and RN-Web 'Invalid style property of background' warning (pre-existing shorthand pattern, P2).
